setup_logging_to_file: setup logging to write messages to a specified log file with a given log level
setup_logging_to_stdout: setup logging to write messages to stdout with a given log level and no file handler
setup_logging_with_hostname: setup logging with hostname included in the log message format for multi-host environments
setup_logging_debug_level: setup logging at debug level to capture all log messages including debug output
setup_logging_error_level: setup logging at error level to capture only error and critical messages
